defects.title: Invalid regex in DataVisualizationAgent._extract_missing_columns raises re.error and crashes the visualization path whenever the generated chart code fails
defects.expected_behavior: When the generated visualization code fails, the agent should parse the error, run its fix loop and either return a chart or a clear error message; the helper regex must compile.
defects.observed_behavior: In both rounds, chart requests (round-1 steps 2/4/6, round-2 steps 2/4) failed with re.error 'unbalanced parenthesis at position 10' raised from execute_data_visualization_code (data_visualization_agent.py:775, invalid pattern r"\\['([^']+)'\\]\\s+not in index"); the step status is failed with no output and the fix loop never runs. Reproduction: 2 of 2 valid rounds on this source (212f3981b1f7).
